reviews.title: Not enough updates
reviews.text: I love this game but there hasn’t been an update in a very long time! Disappointing

reviews.title: Fun, but…
reviews.text: I enjoy a fun puzzle game, but as someone who is colorblind the game can be a bit of a struggle sometimes. It doesn’t make the game 100% unplayable, but having less objects that look the exact same besides a slight change in color would be a nice accessibility fix

reviews.title: MATTEL MATCH
reviews.text:
WHAT A WAY TO KICK OFF MATTEL’S 80TH BIRTHDAY!
BARBIE,  BARNEY AND OTHER CLASSIC TOYS ARE COMPLETELY SCATTERED ABOUT.  JUST MATCH 3 OF THE 

SAME TOYS EACH TIME.

reviews.title: Awesome new Mattel game!
reviews.text: Just downloaded this game and I’m hooked already! Love seeing all the iconic Mattel toys! Also, awesome that there are no ads but not sure how long that will last. Hopefully stays that way!

reviews.title: Great match game
reviews.text: Very few adds great game if you like all Mattel characters you will enjoy this game if 10 stars I would give it !

reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: Glad to see my childhood hero Barney on there. Also, Twinklen hasn’t been here for a long time!
